comment: Drop your own looping audio files in this folder and list them here. They appear in the Sounds library alongside the built-in synthesised ones, with their own volume, and work in mixes and presets identically. Nothing is fetched from the internet - files are served from this app only.

sounds.name: Rain on leaves
sounds.description: Steady rain falling on foliage — a continuous outdoor bed.

sounds.name: Light rainfall
sounds.description: Soft rain without thunder; loops cleanly for long sessions.

sounds.name: Forest ambience
sounds.description: Birds and woodland air recorded outdoors.

sounds.name: Ocean waves
sounds.description: Waves breaking on a shore — a two-minute steady loop.

sounds.name: Soft murmur
sounds.description: Gentle room-tone pink noise with rare soft taps — a cafe-like bed generated for this app.
